title.narrative: Strengthening Action Against Corruption (SAAC)

description.narrative:
Overall objective: To improve democratic accountability and transparency in South Africa through the empowerment of its citizens.

Specific objective 1: To enhance the role of rural communities in contributing to governance, accountability, and transparency in the Eastern Cape Province (ECP).

Specific objective 2: To improve advocacy at local and national level to eradicate corruption utilising knowledge and evidence gathered in rural communities of the ECP.
